column1: # Helena local AI: the models install.sh may place, each pinned to a repository commit and the
# SHA-256 of every file (docs/helena-decisions/local-ai-platform.md §5). The name is the one
# Lemonade's model registry uses for the same checkpoint, so Lemonade finds the files offline;
# `user.` names are registered with Lemonade after placing (install.sh models pull).
# kind flm: FastFlowLM pulls the model itself (repo = its tag); files/sha256 are what it must
# have fetched (checked by `models verify`). A download over 1 GB needs the owner's OK first.
# Roles (after the evals decide): workhorse = Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-MTP, heavy = Qwen3.8-27B,
# candidates = gpt-oss-120b, Mistral-Small-4, embeddings = Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B (GPU),
# NPU = whisper-v3-turbo, qwen3.5-2b (router); embed-gemma only for comparison (Gemma terms).
# Tab-separated: name kind unit repo commit files sizes total sha256s license ctx backend
# backend: the llama.cpp engine Lemonade loads the model with: rocm (the default, our HIP build)
# or vulkan; `bench.sh speed <name>` measures both, the faster one is written here.
